messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary failure detected for rollout `canary/2026-03-15-09` service=model-serving-canary region=us-east-1 error=KMS.DecryptError: AccessDenied. Canary health check failing (decrypt). No automatic rollback configured for this change.

aisha_oncall: paging oncall (I got the page). oncall response team: I'm awake, taking incident.

priya_sre: reading alerts — looks like decrypt errors started right after the deploy finished ~09:12 UTC. Can anyone confirm a key rotation or policy change around that time?

luis_security: we rotated a key for billing KMS alias `alias/redwood-prod-llm` during the scheduled key rotation window at 08:55 UTC. Rotation itself succeeded but IIRC we pushed a narrower key policy earlier in the day for least-privilege testing. Investigating whether service role was dropped.

tom_infra: on it. I'm SSHing to the canary pod logs. quick tail: ```2026-03-15T09:12:34Z ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-service is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh```

priya_sre: noted. That matches. Who last changed the KMS key policy? luis?

luis_security: yep that was me. I intended to tighten the key policy to replace broad `Principal: "*"` with the service role, but I accidentally removed the `kms:Decrypt` statement for the service role when testing. Reverting now. Sorry.

priya_sre: ok pause — we need mitigation before revert if the rollout is live. Two mitigations: 1) kill the feature flag / kill-switch for the new KMS flow so traffic falls back to old path OR 2) rollback the canary to previous image. Which is faster?

tom_infra: kill flag is fastest. I can flip the flag in LaunchDarkly. Rolling back will take ~4m to complete and we'll still have to ensure no pods stuck. I'll flip flag and follow up with rollback if needed.

aisha_oncall: agree kill flag first. tom, flip the flag and confirm canary health. If that doesn't clear within 3m we rollback.

tom_infra: flipping `ff:new_kms_flow` to false now. ```ld toggle ff:new_kms_flow --env prod --off```

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag change recorded: ff:new_kms_flow=false by tom_infra at 09:16:01 UTC. Canary healthcheck retry scheduled.

priya_sre: canary healthchecks are improving, connection attempts dropping. tom can you post canary pod logs after the flag flip?

tom_infra: logs show decrypt errors stop immediately after flag flip. new errors are gone. snippet: ```09:16:05 INFO using legacy-kms-path; 09:16:05 INFO decrypt success``` Looks like kill-switch worked.

sam_support: rough customer impact numbers: we saw elevated latencies for 2% of requests between 09:12-09:16 UTC and ~120 calls failed (mostly low-volume customers on new routing). No major accounts reported errors yet. I'll notify support ops to watch tickets.

priya_sre: good rapid mitigation. Next step: fix root cause (restore KMS key policy or update IAM role). luis, can you push a corrected key policy that includes `kms:Decrypt` for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-service`? If it needs out-of-band approval, tell us.

luis_security: preparing policy patch. Planned policy snippet to add: ```{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-service"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}``` Will apply in staging then prod. ETA ~10m.

priya_sre: apply directly to prod now — we need service decrypt to function. luis, confirm after apply. Also, ensure the key rotation metadata is consistent so future rotations reapply correct policy.

luis_security: applying to prod now. ```aws kms put-key-policy --key-id abcd-efgh --policy file://fixed-policy.json```

luis_security: :white_check_mark: Policy updated 09:26:12 UTC. Verifying decrypt with a smoke request...

priya_sre: tom, can you trigger the canary healthcheck or run the canary job manually to confirm?

tom_infra: running canary job: ```kubectl -n canary exec canary-abc -- /app/bin/canary_check --attempt 1``` Result: decrypt succeeded, full end-to-end success.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary back to healthy at 09:27:02 UTC. No further failures observed.

priya_sre: ok revert the feature flag to the new flow only after we validate the role+policy across all regions. We should also add a guard to deployment pipeline that ensures KMS key policy changes include a service role `kms:Decrypt` allow.

aisha_oncall: handoff: priya you're incident lead. I'll stay for postmortem notes then head to next shift in 10m. Incident severity: Sev3 (partial failure, mitigated quickly).

sam_support: posting interim customer communication: "We saw brief errors for a small percentage of requests during a configuration change; services are restored and no major accounts were impacted. Support is monitoring." Will update outbound if any tickets escalate.

priya_sre: action items captured: 1) luis to fix key policy and confirm rotation config (done) 2) tom to add pipeline check for key policy diff (owner tom_infra) 3) aisha to create incident in tracker and assign postmortem (owner aisha_oncall) 4) sam to run customer impact sweep and create support thread (owner sam_support).

incident-bot: :page_facing_up: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-47 (linked). Priority set: P3. Participants auto-notified.

luis_security: I'll open a PR to sanitize the rotation tooling so it enforces required principals for service roles. Link coming in 30m.

priya_sre: timeline for postmortem: capture exact changelist that modified the KMS policy, why tests didn't catch it, and add a canary gating rule for KMS decrypt errors to auto-kill feature flags or pause rollouts.

aisha_oncall: changing status to monitoring. If we see any regression I'll repage. Thanks everyone for fast response. :thumbsup:

sam_support: support ops monitoring, updating customers if anything changes.

tom_infra: I'll sketch the pipeline check today — basic `aws kms get-key-policy` diff step + fail build if `kms:Decrypt` missing for service role.

priya_sre: closing thread in 1h unless anything new. Assigning postmortem to aisha and priya as leads, tom and luis as contributors.

incident-bot: :lock: Incident INC-2026-0315-47 status: RESOLVED (09:45:10 UTC). Root cause: KMS key policy misconfiguration during rotation removed decrypt permissions for service role; mitigated via feature flag kill-switch and policy restore. Postmortem assigned.

aisha_oncall: thanks all — small outage window, good containment. PR/notes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0315-47

priya_sre: postmortem checklist: add pipeline gating, test rotation in staging with canary, document runbook for KMS rotations and rollback patterns.

luis_security: apologizing for the break, will add more safety checks.

sam_support: closing loop with customers now.

priya_sre: :white_check_mark: Incident closed.
